amendments.issue: The strict-majority helper rejected the two remaining producers in leave-one-out gold construction.
amendments.change: Allow strict majority over any non-empty label count; with two labels, disagreement remains undefined.

amendments.issue: The runner checked gate direction but not the exact predeclared numeric signature. The positive-control floor was 2/3 rather than the preregistered 0.8.
amendments.change: Add exact checks for every predeclared numeric signature and use a 700-item positive control whose leave-one-out denominator is transparent.
amendments.reason_for_parameter_change: The prior positive control could not produce the predeclared 0.8 floor under the frozen strict-majority leave-one-out rule.

amendments.issue: The positive-control paired discordance was miscomputed in the preregistration as 70/0; the frozen runner observed 280/0.
amendments.change: Correct the positive-control discordance derivation from 70/0 to 280/0; gate rule, critical construction, negative control, and hypothesis remain unchanged.

scope.target: construct validity of a producer-baseline readability gate

research_question: Is clearing a producer leave-one-out baseline a necessary condition for every top ordering that is deterministic and stable under single-item deletion?

hypotheses.H0: For the declared producer-baseline gate, every top ordering that is deterministic and stable under every single-item deletion must clear the producer floor.
hypotheses.H1: There exists a finite synthetic construction in which the top ordering is deterministic and stable under every single-item deletion, yet the producer-baseline gate refuses.
hypotheses.decision_rule: Reject H0 if the critical and both control conditions exactly match their predeclared signatures in two byte-identical runs.

design.gold_rule: strict majority of the three producer labels
design.producer_floor: maximum producer accuracy against the strict-majority gold formed from the other two producers
design.leaderboard_score: candidate accuracy against the full strict-majority gold

primary_endpoint: Whether the critical condition refuses while the A-minus-B ordering is stable under all 700 single-item deletions and has 280 one-way versus 0 reverse paired observations.
falsification_condition: H1 is not supported if any control signature fails, if the critical gate is readable, if the ordering changes under any defined single-item deletion, or if the paired discordance is not 280 versus 0.
stopping_rule: Execute the frozen runner exactly twice. If the two result files are not byte-identical, stop with a reproducibility failure and do not reinterpret either run.

analysis_plan.pairing: A and B are compared on the same strict-majority gold item set.
analysis_plan.stability: Delete each item once, recompute both accuracies on the remaining 999 items, and require the predeclared relation in every defined deletion.
analysis_plan.paired_test: Report the exact one-sided sign-test tail 2^-d where d is the number of discordant items, conditional on the predeclared item-exchangeability null.
analysis_plan.gate_check: Apply the same numeric margin threshold to every condition.

interpretation_limits: A successful run rejects the broad necessity interpretation only in the declared synthetic construction.
It does not estimate the prevalence of this pattern in public leaderboards.
It does not show that producer leave-one-out scores are uninformative in all settings.
It does not establish the manuscript's publication readiness, novelty, acceptance, or arXiv authorization.
It does not replace an external gold-pool study for the manuscript's empirical claim.
